annotations.title: Re-fetch a venue and diff it against our baseline (paid, x402)

description: PAID: detect API drift: we re-fetch a venue we snapshot and diff it against our baseline (fields added, removed, moved). Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

venue.description: A venue id we hold a baseline snapshot for; list them free with drift_venues. A venue we have never snapshotted is refused (404).
